meta.title: A published stage has a bidding-time schedule row with a non-null end time
gaps: The plan verifies that the pricing round exposes non-null start and end times, but cannot directly verify the presence of a separate trade_schedules bidding-time row.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “starting from” is not null; “ending at” is not null.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “starting from” is not null; “ending at” is not null.
